title: observability: automate prometheus/grafana & log shipping for private installs
author: Priya Patel
description: Add automated observability stack for Private installs: PrometheusOperator + serviceMonitors, Grafana dashboards provisioning, centralized alert rules, and log shipping with Vector. This change wires the Helm charts used by private-installer and updates the Terraform modules used by infra-provisioning so customers deployed via 'redwood-private-installer' have an opinionated, production-ready observability stack by default. Motivation: reduce manual post-install steps for on-prem/VPC customers, ensure consistent alerting coverage, and make upgrades/rollbacks of observability components safe. Changes include: (1) Helm chart updates for redwood-observability: new subchart prometheus-operator with CRDs templated, Grafana provisioning configmaps and dashboards as JSONnet->JSON export, Vector as a daemonset with optional sidecar mode, networkPolicy and PodDisruptionBudget defaults for on-prem stability. (2) Terraform module redwood-private-network: optional managed route53/private-dns records for AlertManager webhooks, IAM policy template for S3-compatible object storage used by Grafana snapshots, and optional VPC endpoint modules for Prometheus remote_write ingestion. (3) Installer orchestration: post-install hooks in the Helm release to apply alertmanagerReceiver secrets using sealed-secrets when KMS is present; an upgrade/rollback hook that snapshots current Grafana provisioning state and re-applies dashboards on rollback. (4) Observability automation tasks: onboarding job to create default alert suppression windows for maintenance and a reconcile job to ensure ServiceMonitors remain in sync after node scaling events. The PR includes docs and a teardown test plan for private installs. Testing performed: local k3s verification, integration test on a QA VPC cluster (aws eu-west-1), and CI linting for Helm/Terraform. Backwards compatibility: existing installs that opt-out via values.observability.enabled=false are unaffected. Rollback plan: Helm revert triggers the pre-rollback hook which restores previous Grafana provisioning and re-applies PrometheusRule backups stored in a PVC snapshot or S3-compatible bucket if configured.
commits: feat(obs): add prometheus-operator subchart and CRDs || feat(obs): add grafana provisioning and default dashboards || feat(obs): add vector daemonset + optional sidecar mode || infra(terraform): add optional vpc_endpoint and alertmanager route records || installer: add post-install/upgrade/rollback hooks and reconcile jobs || test: add k3s integration test and terraform plan smoke tests || docs: observability automation and teardown guide
review_conversation: Miguel Santos (reviewer): Left a suggestion to tighten ServiceMonitor label selectors to avoid scraping system namespaces. Priya replied that selectors are now namespaced and added tests to verify no cross-namespace scraping.
Riley Carter (reviewer): Asked to add PodDisruptionBudget for Prometheus replicas; updated helm templates to generate PDBs with clusterSize-aware defaults.
Alex Nguyen (reviewer): Noted potential sensitive config in grafana provisioning that references S3 credentials. Author added sealed-secrets support and documented KMS-backed secret steps.
CI Bot: integration tests passed. Approvals required from two approvers.
release_notes: Added opinionated observability automation for Private installs: PrometheusOperator + ServiceMonitors, Grafana provisioning and default dashboards, Vector log shipping, Terraform hooks for VPC endpoints and AlertManager routing. Opt-out available via values.observability.enabled=false.
notes: This PR was part of the Private deployment observability automation epic. Follow-up tasks: add tenant-scoped alert suppression UI in console (ENG-4800) and streamline Grafana snapshots to object-store lifecycle (ENG-4812).
